en: Multi-view color postcard with six framed photos from the city of Reșița: a modern school building, Lake Secu with forested hills and the "Constructorul" hotel, a wide plaza/steps area, the stalactite interior of Comarnic Cave, a landscaped park in front of the administrative palace and the "Semenic" hotel, and a city square with a tall modern building. The word RESITA appears vertically in red on the front. The back shows Romanian postal layout with 'POSTA ROMANA', 'CARTE POSTALA', an imprinted 40 BANI stamp with the socialist coat of arms, address lines, and a bilingual Romanian–French caption list describing the views.
